name: livesignal
description: Research video knowledge and co-create cited, illustrated canvases with LiveSignal.

interface.shortDescription: Turn video research into cited visual canvases.
interface.longDescription: Pair browser navigation with LiveSignal's WebMCP tools to research videos, preserve timestamped evidence, respond to human canvas edits, and create clearly labeled illustrations on request.
defaultPrompt: Research this topic across relevant videos and build a cited canvas.
Respond to my canvas comments and improve the selected card.
Create a labeled illustration for this card without treating it as evidence.
